tldr: NVIDIA's Oct 2 post pitched DGX Spark 64GB as a local-AI box for builders. A hands-on report on Oct 5 ran the 552B DeepSeek V4.1-Flash on four linked Sparks.
whats_new: Oct 13: NVIDIA says the PC app ecosystem is ready for RTX Spark, a laptop superchip with up to 128GB unified memory.
why_it_matters: Large unified memory is the constraint for local agent and open-model work, so Spark-class hardware sets what you can prototype off-cloud.

status.detail: Spark moved from a desktop dev box to an RTX laptop superchip within two weeks.

beats.headline: DGX Spark 64GB pitched for local AI development
Four Sparks run DeepSeek V4.1-Flash (552B) at a reported 494 tokens/s peak
RTX Spark brings the platform to PCs with 128GB unified memory

open_questions: Do independent tests reproduce the 494 tokens/s peak on four Sparks outside peak conditions?
What do RTX Spark laptops cost versus DGX Spark desktops?
take_for_builders: Treat the 494 tokens/s figure as a peak from one rig; benchmark your own model and context length before buying Spark hardware.
